name: Minimap — Instantly map Places & Addresses
description: A small Mapbox map you can open on any webpage. Search any address, place, city, or landmark. Movable and resizable.
author: seïn

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://api.mapbox.com https://events.mapbox.com https://*.tiles.mapbox.com https://minimap-geocode.minimapextension.workers.dev https://minimap-mapbox.minimapextension.workers.dev; worker-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://api.mapbox.com https://*.tiles.mapbox.com;
